UpdateSourceArgs: -c "test -f venice-unleashed/bf3/bf3.exe || { echo 'BF3 game files missing: upload your full Battlefield 3 installation into venice-unleashed/bf3/ (bf3.exe must be directly inside).'; exit 1; }"
-c "test -f venice-unleashed/instance/server.key || { echo 'server.key missing: create one at https://veniceunleashed.net/keys and upload it to venice-unleashed/instance/server.key'; exit 1; }"

-c "export WINEPREFIX=\"{{$FullRootDir}}.wine\" WINEARCH=win32 WINEDEBUG=-all; cd venice-unleashed; if [ -n \"{{EaToken}}\" ] && [ ! -f .activated ]; then wine client/vu.com -gamepath \"{{$FullBaseDir}}bf3\" -activate -ea_token \"{{EaToken}}\" && touch .activated; wineserver -w; fi"
